name: Archaeological Areas of Pompei, Herculaneum and Torre Annunziata
description: On the Bay of Naples, three Roman sites lie where Vesuvius buried them on 24 August AD 79. Pompei's sprawling streets show a busy trading town, while Herculaneum, a smaller seaside resort, is far better preserved. At Torre Annunziata, the Villa Oplontis dazzles with wall paintings that reveal how wealthy Romans lived.
